ISO 8099-1 Holding Tank Labels

Sewage systems and toilet waste holding tanks — ready-to-print on-product labels

RCD 2013/53/EU Annex I 5.8 · ISO 8099-1:2018
These ten labels cover a holding-tank sewage installation for requirement 5.8. Print the whole sheet, or use Download PNG on any single label to print and apply it on the boat. Fill in the blanks (manufacturer, model, capacity) before fitting the identification and capacity labels.
